responsibility: Implements the RTL-side support routines for GCC’s Pointer Bounds Checker (CHKP) instrumentation. This file manages a temporary mapping from tree nodes to the RTL values that carry their bounds, splits and rejoins PARALLEL argument/return slots into ordinary value and bounds components, normalizes multi-register slots into EXPR_LIST form, and emits backend code to load, store, and copy pointer bounds for stack-passed arguments and aggregate stack parameters through targetm.calls bounds hooks and tree-chkp-derived bound-slot discovery.
same_name_distinction: Defines the RTL Pointer Bounds Checker implementation behind this stem: it owns the bounds map state and emits/manipulates RTL for splitting/joining value-vs-bounds slots and for loading, storing, and copying bounds via target call hooks. Unlike rtl-chkp.h, this is the executable implementation file rather than the interface declaration layer.
